verdict_reason: Pure, behaviour-preserving rename that is consistent across every caller, but the file's doc comment was left in the old vocabulary and now describes indexes as fulfilmentIds, which is the naming confusion AC 3 asks to remove.

todos.issue: Doc comment (lines 3-11) still says 'fulfilmentId' where the renamed function now returns fulfilment indexes: 'A group's instance fulfilmentId is the first N segments of any descendant leaf's composite fulfilmentId' and 'Returns Map<group obligation id, Set<group fulfilmentId>>'. Under the ticket's vocabulary a fulfilmentId is <obligationId>:<index>, so the comment now contradicts both the code and AC 3, which is the exact confusion this PR exists to remove.
todos.fix: Rewrite the comment to say fulfilment index (e.g. 'the first N segments of any descendant leaf's composite fulfilment index'; 'Returns Map<group obligation id, Set<group fulfilment index>>'), and rename the local 'const ids' at line 26 to 'indexes' so the whole function reads in the new vocabulary.
